build_mim_head: build a MIMHead instance with a loss config dict for masked image modeling pre-training
build_loss_module: build a loss module from a config dict using MODELS.build for the MIMHead
compute_loss: compute the MIMHead loss given prediction and target tensors with optional mask
review_mim_head: review the MIMHead class and its loss method for masked image modeling
test_mim_head_loss: test the MIMHead loss method with batched prediction and target tensors
